subject: Call for nominations, Polmeth Statistical Software Award! Email schrodt AT psu DOT edu

messages.author: 949f9be37ba0e6cd
messages.subject: Call for nominations, Polmeth Statistical Software Award! Email schrodt AT psu DOT edu
parts:
Dear list reader and lavaan user.

For several years now, Yves has worked tirelessly to give us lavaan and provide support, all absolutely for free. 

If you would like to show your appreciation for his efforts, why not nominate him for the Society for Political Methodology's Statistical Software Award? You don't have to be a political scientist, but it helps! You can nominate Yves by sending an email to Prof Phil Schrodt (schrodt AT psu DOT edu) explaining to the Society why he deserves this token of appreciation for his huge efforts. 

All the best,
Daniel
